name: Siemens Systems Modeler with SysMLv2
description: A web-based collaborative platform for graphical SysML v2 modeling with textual import, standard SysML v2 API access, auto-layout, and Teamcenter integration.
editorialNote: Added from NeoMBSE's 2026-10-23 coverage audit. The OMG directory is used because it contains the vendor-supplied product description and verification details.

sysmlV2Api.note: The directory states that REST, OSLC, and API access use standard SysML v2 calls.

classificationNotes: Teamcenter is an external integration; it is not treated as the modeler's host application.
Textual SysML v2 import is not counted as XMI import.
